scopes.why: Read the current Cognito session via Amplify's fetchAuthSession() (decoded ID token payload) to expose the signed-in user via useAuth().
Sign the user out (Amplify signOut) when the app calls useAuth().signOut().

Verify a request's Cognito access token server-side by calling the user pool's own OAuth2 GET {userPoolDomain}/oauth2/userInfo endpoint, applying fail-closed handling before any protected server route trusts the caller. Requires an access token obtained via the Hosted UI / OAuth2 authorization-code flow (scoped) — tokens from a direct username/password InitiateAuth call are not accepted by this endpoint.
